findings.evidence: `Theorem.lean:70` states `Contractable μ X ↔ Exchangeable μ X ∧ ConditionallyIID μ X`; `Exchangeability/ConditionallyIIDImplications.lean:88` proves `ConditionallyIID.exchangeable`, and `:102` proves `ConditionallyIID.contractable`, so the natural theorem drops the redundant exchangeability conjunct.
findings.fix: First add/prove `contractable_iff_conditionallyIID : Contractable μ X ↔ ConditionallyIID μ X` using `conditionallyIID_of_contractable` and `ConditionallyIID.contractable`, then derive this roadmap conjunction wrapper from it with `ConditionallyIID.exchangeable`.
findings.issue: `contractable_iff_exchangeable_and_conditionallyIID` makes `Exchangeable μ X` part of the main equivalence even though it is redundant once `ConditionallyIID μ X` is known.

summary: The Ryll-Nardzewski wrapper is stated one level too specifically: the natural equivalence available from the existing API is `Contractable μ X ↔ ConditionallyIID μ X`, with the exchangeability conjunct derivable afterward.
